name: world-shaking movement
desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to its Speed. At the end of this movement, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} creates an instantaneous shock wave in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=g4W0ovZxBeUrZKb8]]-[[lookup @target.template.units activity=g4W0ovZxBeUrZKb8]]. Emanation originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose &Reference[Concentration] and, if Medium or smaller, have the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
